metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A high-energy superhero adventure about family teamwork that matches the action in Spider-Verse and Sonic.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A touching adventure film with great humor and heart, perfect for fans of Inside Out and Finding Nemo.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A classic comedy about friendship and overcoming fears, similar in tone to Toy Story and Despicable Me.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A charming coming-of-age story set in Italy that captures the same whimsical summer vibe as Ponyo.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: Explores complex emotions and family expectations through vibrant animation, much like Turning Red and Inside Out 2.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A fantasy quest involving two brothers that will resonate with fans of Raya and the Last Dragon and adventure films.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A perfect blend of technology, action, and emotional heart for kids who enjoyed the Spider-Verse movies.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A fun exploration of video game worlds that fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic will love.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A heartwarming story about unconventional families and friendship, similar to Moana's tropical adventure.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic fantasy adventure with high-flying action that aligns with the scale of The Sea Beast.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious subversion of superhero tropes that fans of Despicable Me and The Bad Guys will enjoy.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A fast-paced animal comedy with a memorable cast of characters similar to those in Zootopia and Migration.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A prehistoric family adventure that emphasizes staying together, perfect for fans of Shrek and Kung Fu Panda.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across China to help a Yeti get home, sharing the wonder of movies like Turning Red.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A quirky and visually unique family road trip film that matches the energy of Spider-Verse and The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An inventive and wacky comedy about science gone wrong that kids who liked Despicable Me will find hilarious.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A spooky but very funny family comedy that focuses on a father-daughter bond, like a comedic version of Mufasa.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: A fast-paced, highly creative adventure with humor that appeals to fans of the Mario and Sonic movies.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A genuinely kind and wholesome story about a bear in London, perfect for fans of Ghibli's gentler films.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A rare sequel that surpasses the original with its charm, humor, and beautiful family themes.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Another Ghibli masterpiece about tiny people living in secret, perfect for fans of The Borrowers.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who visits a magical cat kingdom, similar to Alice in Wonderland.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: The exciting sequel to Chicken Run, continuing the fun heist-style adventures of the flock.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A brilliantly funny stop-motion film from the creators of Wallace & Gromit that relies on visual storytelling.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: A comedy-filled prequel showing how Gru started his journey, ideal for fans of Despicable Me.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A sweet, nostalgic, and gentle film that captures the innocent charm of My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: An animal-led adventure with a lot of humor and a core focus on a makeshift family's bond.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An action-adventure about a dog who thinks he has superpowers, perfect for fans of Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest comedies with a fast-paced humor style similar to Shrek.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The continuation of Po's journey as he learns more about his heritage and masters new skills.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: The heartfelt sequel to Finding Nemo that explores Dory's backstory and the meaning of family.

metas.name: Trolls Band Together
metas.description: A vibrant, music-filled adventure that will appeal to kids who enjoyed Sing and KPop Demon Hunters.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A funny and surprisingly wise movie about a class lizard that offers great life lessons for kids.

metas.name: Nimona
metas.description: A bold and unique fantasy adventure with a shapeshifting protagonist that fans of Raya will enjoy.

metas.name: Smallfoot
metas.description: A fun musical comedy that flips the Bigfoot legend on its head with a message about truth and friendship.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: The fun prequel to Monsters, Inc. showing the origins of Mike and Sulley's friendship.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical musical tale in the tradition of Tangled and Moana about the power of making a wish.

metas.name: Strange World
metas.description: A pulp-style sci-fi adventure through an alien ecosystem that fits the exploration themes of Castle in the Sky.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A beautiful musical fantasy based on Chinese mythology that fans of Moana and Coco will adore.
